Page Pros vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
Page Pros and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare Page Pros vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

Page Pros is a local SEO agency that helps businesses rank on Google, with social media, ads and website services alongside [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media, and in many ways they fit together.

Page Pros describes itself as a local SEO agency, with offices in Toronto and Miami [1]. Page Pros’ services cover Google rankings (RankPRO), managed Instagram pages (InstaPRO), full social media management (SocialPRO), branding (BrandPRO), pay-per-click ads (LeadPRO) and websites (WebPRO) [1]. RankPRO starts at $299 a month plus a $500 setup fee, with no contract [2]. Its social media services are priced separately: InstaPRO starts at $499 a month and SocialPRO at $999 a month, each plus a $500 setup fee [3][4].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.
Google rankings are Page Pros’ core

Page Pros’ RankPRO works to rank your business in Google’s top 3 in your area, with a local search audit, citation building and tracking, a rank tracker and a monthly call with your Pro [2]. Its RankPRO+ add-on publishes daily posts to your Google Business Profile for $199 a month [2].
Both post to social, in different ways

Page Pros’ InstaPRO manages your Instagram page with one weekly page post and one weekly story post [3]. Its SocialPRO service covers content writing and scheduling, from 2 posts a week on 2 platforms up to 7 posts a week on 3 platforms [4].
Page Pros prices each service separately, each with a one-time setup fee and no contract: RankPRO $299 to $399 a month, InstaPRO $499 to $699 a month and SocialPRO $999 to $1,999 a month [2][3][4].
Page Pros works with many kinds of local business, and its InstaPRO page templates cover real estate, restaurants, trades, professionals and beauty [3].

Yes, as separate services. Page Pros’ InstaPRO manages your Instagram page from $499 a month plus a $500 setup fee, and SocialPRO covers content writing and scheduling from $999 a month plus a $500 setup fee, with 2 posts a week on 2 platforms at that level [3][4].
Who does Page Pros work with?
Page Pros works with local businesses across many industries, real estate among them; its InstaPRO templates cover real estate, restaurants, trades, professionals and beauty [3].
How much does Page Pros cost?

Page Pros lists RankPRO at $299, $349 or $399 a month with setup fees of $500, $750 or $1,000; InstaPRO at $499, $599 or $699 a month; and SocialPRO at $999, $1,499 or $1,999 a month, each with a setup fee and no contract [2][3][4].
Can I use Page Pros and VEXI together?
Yes. Page Pros’ core is ranking your business on Google [2]; VEXI’s is your social content.
